entries.text: 歡迎光臨冰櫃道館！\n要再聽一次道館測驗的說明嗎？
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_receptionist_01

entries.text: 冰櫃道館的道館測驗是……\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]開場表演[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！\r\n……也就是所謂的暖場秀！
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_receptionist_02

entries.text: 在道館館主的演唱會開始之前，\n請[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳在舞台上進行寶可夢對戰！\r\n用火花四濺的決鬥炒熱觀眾席！
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_receptionist_03

entries.text: 只要到演唱會場和主持人說一聲，\n就可以開始道館測驗囉。
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_receptionist_04

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳來啦！負責暖場的訓練家！\n我的名字叫ＭＣ卡蒙！\r\n演唱會的會場在這邊喔！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_01

entries.text: 接下來要請[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳\n同時派出２隻寶可夢，\r\n進行雙打對戰！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_02

entries.text: [EMPTY 55]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_03

entries.text: 只要[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳能打出轟動全場的雙打對戰，\n讓場上刺激雙倍，觀眾熱度翻倍！\r\n現場就會分貝加倍！冰櫃也會雪融成水！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_04

entries.text: 只要讓演唱會場氣氛熱起來，\n館主高高興興上台！\r\n道館測驗就算通過啦！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_05

entries.text: 站上舞台，好戲就開場囉！\n要是沒有連贏３場，一律不准中途退場！\r\n挑戰時可要做好覺悟啊！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_19

entries.text: 開場表演＆道館測驗！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳準備好要轟動全場了嗎！？[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_06

entries.text: 準備好了！
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_select_01

entries.text: 還沒
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_select_02

entries.text: 聽說明
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_select_03

entries.text: 唉呀呀！這道館測驗\n得要有至少２隻能對戰的寶可夢喔！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_no_double

entries.text: 這可是個責任重大的工作！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要仔細做好準備啊！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_cancel

entries.text: 那就不做預演，直接正式開始囉！\n上台去吧！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_07

entries.text: 各位先生女士！\n本次演唱會的開場表演是由\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]帶來的雙打對戰３連戰～！！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_20

entries.text: 首先前來阻擋挑戰者[VAR 0x0100(0000)]\n的對手是……[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_21

entries.text: 呼喚微風的少年藝人，\n幽漾！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_30

entries.text: 雙打對戰……１＋１……\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳知道答案是什麼嗎？
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_boy_01

entries.text: [EMPTY 55]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_08

entries.text: [EMPTY 55]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_09

entries.text: [EMPTY 55]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_10

entries.text: [EMPTY 55]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_11

entries.text: [EMPTY 55]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_12

entries.text: [EMPTY 55]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_poke_01

entries.text: 觀眾席的歡呼聲\n稍微變大了！
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_system_01

entries.text: 冰櫃舞台用的是最新技術！\n觀眾越是火熱，\r\n舞台的燈就會越亮眼！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_22

entries.text: Come on！保持這個氣勢，\n繼續轟動全場吧！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_23

entries.text: 進入下一場對戰！\n這次的對手是……[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_24

entries.text: 挑聽眾的音樂家！\n貝夏米！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_25

entries.text: 互補弱點，變得強大！\n這就是２隻寶可夢齊聲呈現的和聲！
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_musician_01

entries.text: 觀眾席籠罩在\n火熱的氣氛中！
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_system_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]的表演讓現場的\n歡呼聲和燈光都變得越來越熱鬧啦～！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_26

entries.text: 這真是天外飛來的驚喜！\n想不到[VAR 0x0100(0000)]會表現得如此勁爆！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_27

entries.text: 接下來就是壓軸的第３人啦。\n最後的對手是……[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_28

entries.text: 我！ＭＣ卡蒙！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_29

entries.text: 主持與寶可夢都是我的拿手絕活！\n看我雙管齊下，把[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳耍得團團轉！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_31

entries.text: 觀眾的熱情達到最高潮了！
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_system_03

entries.text: 哇～！哇～！\n好驚人的對戰啊！
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mobs_01

entries.text: 太難得了！\n這種對戰很少見呢！
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mobs_02

entries.text: 謝謝啦～[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的道館測驗及格了！恭喜！\r\n大家請給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她熱烈的掌聲～！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_13

entries.text: 讓我背脊發涼的一體感！\n呼喚主角登場的準備完～美就緒啦！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_14

entries.text: 那麼，請各位一起呼喊吧！\n我們今天的主角……[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_15

entries.text: Come on！\n深情靈魂饒舌樂……萊～～姆！！[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_16

entries.text: 萊姆！萊姆！萊姆！\n萊姆！萊姆！萊姆！
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mobs_03

entries.text: 高分貝的歡呼！讓我感到嫉妒！\n你是高興得想哭，還是樂得想跳舞！？[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_ghost_03

entries.text: Yeah！！想跳舞～！！\n萊姆！萊姆！萊姆！萊姆！
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mobs_04

entries.text: 寶貝，謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳開場！\n只要我來了，就不會無聊囉！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_ghost_04

entries.text: 道館測驗辛苦了。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的表現真的是超棒的。謝謝。[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_17

entries.text: 接下來暫時都是萊姆的演出時段，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳先去道館櫃台報告結果吧。[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_18

entries.text: 觀眾們都被道館館主迷住了！\n……去櫃台報告結果吧！
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_stopper_01
